$comment: Arena's own competitive rank ladder - deliberately NOT Voltaic's names or colours.
Tiers are matched by population percentile; percentile is [lower, upper).
The colours are chosen to match the names rather than to run as a ramp: Arecibo is
the green of a dish's phosphor, Supernova is the red of one. That is the point of
them, so nothing here re-derives them. What is enforced is only that each is a real
hex and that no two tiers share one; anything too dark for the client's ground is
lifted at draw time by legibleOnDark() rather than corrected in this file.
